answer: The whisper test I would run is Signed stable yard record with equestrian centre attestation: a record the centre kept across years of liveries, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a record the centre kept across years of liveries is per-account by construction, and the ridge is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The zenith grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
